items.source: Value object that represents the data that can be used by a SanitizingFunction.
items.translation: 表示可用于 SanitizingFunction 的数据的值对象。

items.source: Abstract base class for ExposableEndpoint implementations.
items.translation: 用于 ExposableEndpoint 实现的抽象基类。

items.source: Resolver for the permitted level of access to an endpoint.

items.source: Strategy class that can be used to filter endpoints.
items.translation: 可用于过滤 端点 的策略类。

items.source: Provides access to a collection of endpoints.

items.source: An operation on an endpoint.

items.translation: 用于接收 SanitizableData 并在必要时对其值应用脱敏处理的方法。

items.translation: 支持 actuator 端点的注解。

items.source: Interfaces and classes relating to invoking operation methods.
items.translation: 与调用操作方法相关的接口和类。

items.source: Jackson support classes for actuator endpoints.
items.translation: 用于 Actuator 端点的 Jackson 支持类。

items.source: JMX support for actuator endpoints.
items.translation: 用于 actuator 端点的 JMX 支持。

items.source: Web support for actuator endpoints.
items.translation: 用于 actuator 端点的 Web 支持。

items.source:
Tagging interface used to indicate that an operation result is intended to be returned
in the body of the response.
items.translation: 用于指示操作结果旨在返回在响应主体中的标记接口。

items.source: An enumeration of the different types of operation supported by an endpoint.

Strategy that should be used by endpoint implementations to sanitize potentially
sensitive keys.
items.translation: 端点实现应使用的策略，用于清理可能敏感的键。
